column1: # The generated-Go golangci-lint gate's ratchet: per-linter (and for gosec
# per-rule) finding counts per corpus, pinned as measured by the gate at the
# card's head. Columns: corpus<TAB>linter<TAB>rule<TAB>count. A G whose count is
# absent, or higher than its pin, fails naming the linter and both counts; a
# count that stays or falls passes. Blanks pin zero.
